successCriteria.description: All six shared enums (LeaveType, LeaveStatus, EmploymentStatus, BalanceStatus, NotificationType, NotificationStatus) are defined and exported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` with the exact member names and values specified in the reconciled architecture.

The `Employee` entity interface in `src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts` declares all canonical fields (id, employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, managerId, department, hireDate, terminationDate, employmentStatus, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt) with correct types — including `employmentStatus` typed as `EmploymentStatus` enum, not a plain string.

The `IEmployeeRepository` interface declares all six methods — findById, findByEmployeeNumber, findAll, create, update, softDelete — with correct signatures: findById returns `Promise<Employee | null>`, create accepts `Omit<Employee, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt' | 'deletedAt'>`, softDelete returns `Promise<void>`.

The `LeavePolicy` entity interface in `src/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.model.ts` declares all canonical fields (id, policyName, leaveType, entitlementDays, accrualRate, maxAccumulation, minimumNoticeDays, requiresManagerApproval, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt) with `leaveType` typed as `LeaveType` enum and optional fields (`accrualRate`, `maxAccumulation`) typed as `number | undefined`.

The `ILeavePolicyRepository` interface declares all five methods — findById, findByLeaveType, findAllActive, create, update — with `findByLeaveType` accepting `LeaveType` enum and `findAllActive` returning `Promise<LeavePolicy[]>`.

The `ILeavePolicyService` interface declares both methods — `getPolicyForLeaveType(leaveType: LeaveType): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>` and `validateEntitlement(employeeId: string, leaveType: LeaveType, requestedDays: number): Promise<boolean>` — with `leaveType` typed as `LeaveType` enum.

constraints: No concrete implementations — this phase produces only type definitions (enums, interfaces). No repository classes, service classes, controllers, or routes are created.
No tests are written in this phase — tests are deferred to Phase 1 part 2/2.
All enum member names and values must match the reconciled architecture exactly — no additions, removals, or renames.
outOfScope: Concrete repository implementations (PgEmployeeRepository, PgLeavePolicyRepository) — deferred to Phase 1 part 2/2.
LeavePolicyService concrete implementation — deferred to Phase 1 part 2/2.
Unit tests for any module — deferred to Phase 1 part 2/2.

entityInvariants.invariant: Every Employee MUST have a unique `employeeNumber` and a unique `email`. The `employmentStatus` MUST be one of the `EmploymentStatus` enum values. `deletedAt` being non-null signals a soft-deleted record; soft-deleted employees MUST be excluded from `findAll` results.

For any given `leaveType`, at most one active (`isActive = true`) LeavePolicy may exist at a time. `entitlementDays` MUST be a positive integer. `minimumNoticeDays` MUST be a non-negative integer. `requiresManagerApproval` defaults to `true` when not explicitly set.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Calling softDelete on an already soft-deleted employee MUST succeed silently (no-op) rather than throwing.

Returns `false` (not an error) when the requested days exceed the policy's entitlementDays, or when no active policy exists for the given leaveType. Returns `true` only when an active policy exists AND requestedDays <= entitlementDays.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `LeaveType` enum imported in `src/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.model.ts` MUST be the same `LeaveType` exported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` — no local redefinition or divergence.
The `EmploymentStatus` enum imported in `src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts` MUST be the same `EmploymentStatus` exported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` — no local redefinition or divergence.

The `Employee` entity interface MUST match the reconciled architecture's Employee attributes (id, employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, managerId, department, hireDate, terminationDate, employmentStatus, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt) — no missing fields, no extra fields.

The `LeavePolicy` entity interface MUST match the reconciled architecture's LeavePolicy attributes (id, policyName, leaveType, entitlementDays, accrualRate, maxAccumulation, minimumNoticeDays, requiresManagerApproval, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt) — no missing fields, no extra fields.

integrationPoints.why: Consumed by both employee and leave-policy modules for enum imports (EmploymentStatus, LeaveType). Will also be consumed by balance, leave-request, notification, and audit-log modules in later phases.
